name: neosian-cache
description: Maintain an already-warm conversation cache while idle, with visible receipts and no automatic cold rebuilds, and tell the agent to wrap up before a subscription usage limit cuts its turn.

enabled.title: Keep warm while idle
enabled.description: Maintain an observed one-hour cache until the session closes. Expired or uncertain caches wait for your next message.

allowApi.title: Allow usage-billed sessions
allowApi.description: Also allow maintenance without subscription usage indicators, when a one-hour cache is observed. Requests use your account's normal billing.

usageNotes.title: Usage-limit notes
usageNotes.description: Tell the agent once when a subscription usage window reaches 85%, and ask it to reach a clean stopping point near the limit. Guidance only: nothing is blocked, sent or scheduled.

waitHorizonHours.title: Wait horizon (hours)
waitHorizonHours.description: When the limit resets within this many hours (1 to 10), the wrap-up note suggests continuing after the reset and keep-warm waits warm for it; otherwise it suggests a handoff note.
